zh-CN.title: 广场互动与媒体能力升级
items: 发言与评论支持点赞，评论按热度和时间排列
LV6 解锁语音发言，LV8 解锁最长 60 秒视频
照片支持 EXIF 信息，发言本人和官方账号可以删除发言

en.title: Richer interactions and media in the Square
items: Statements and comments support likes, with comments ranked by likes and time
Voice statements unlock at LV6 and 60-second videos at LV8
Photos include EXIF details, and authors or official accounts can delete statements
